csv_project_name: On-Call AE for Fullerton Municipal Airport Capital Improve
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Fullerton is requesting Proposals from qualified airport planning, engineering, and environmental firms for the completion of plans and specifications necessary to complete various improvement projects involving designated capital improvement projects at the Fullerton Municipal Airport. Services requested include general consulting, planning, environmental, engineering, surveying, geotechnical consulting and may include construction inspection/management services. The scope of work may include, but not be limited to, the following projects as listed in Fullerton Municipal Airports five-year Airport Capital Improvement Plan: Update Airport Layout Plan South Aircraft Parking Ramp Pavement and Markings Rehabilitation Southeast Hangars Rehabilitation - Phase II AAM/UAM Planning and Feasibility Studies
